copy.tagline: 在 Cursor 中完成本地或远程的记忆服务配置，让 AI 助手记住上下文。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在 Cursor 里编程，希望 AI 助手能跨会话记住内容。
copy.tagline_en: Set up a memory service for Cursor with local or remote options.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code in Cursor and want your AI assistant to remember context.

howto.what: 在 Cursor 上安装 claude-mem:启动本地 worker(默认)或连接远程 worker,并接入对应的 MCP(claude-mem-local 或 claude-mem-remote),让 Claude 通过它访问记忆。
howto.when: 当你需要在 Cursor 上配置 claude-mem 时触发,涵盖本地 worker、远程 worker、本地宿主登录观察器等设置场景。

say.text: 帮我在 Cursor 里装 claude-mem 的本地 worker
把观察器改成 --provider host 的本地宿主登录
say.note: 走回环代理,占用 37778 端口

say.text: 帮我配好远程 worker 的 CLAUDE_MEM_MCP_TOKEN

howto.what_en: Installs claude-mem on Cursor: starts a local worker (default) or connects a remote worker, then wires up the matching MCP — claude-mem-local or claude-mem-remote — for memory access.
howto.when_en: Use when setting up claude-mem on Cursor: local or remote worker, local host-login observer, or remote cmem.ai inference.

say_en.text: Install the local claude-mem worker in Cursor
Switch the observer to --provider host local host-login
say_en.note: Uses the loopback shim on port 37778

say_en.text: Set CLAUDE_MEM_MCP_TOKEN for the remote worker
